name: NV-Reason-CT
task: 3D CT Vision-Language Reasoning, Report Generation, and Question Answering
description: NV-Reason-CT is a native 3D vision-language model for chest and abdominal CT. A Primus 3D ViT encoder (initialized from COLIPRI) passes all 13,824 visual tokens to a Qwen3.5-4B language model with 3D MRoPE, enabling structured report generation, abnormality classification, visual question answering, and step-by-step reasoning directly from NIfTI volumes.
authors: NVIDIA, in collaboration with the NIH National Cancer Institute and the University of Zurich
data_source: CT-RATE, CancerVerse, and an internal NIH dataset (~550,000 QA examples from 70,111 CT volumes)
data_type: 3D CT volumes (NIfTI, Hounsfield units) and text
image_classes: One-channel chest or abdominal CT, resampled to 2 mm isotropic and cropped to 192x192x192 voxels
intended_use: Research and education only; not a medical device and not for clinical diagnosis or treatment decisions
references: NV-Reason-CT: 3D Visual Language Model for CT Analysis. arXiv preprint arXiv:2609.27511 (2026).
